summary.text: Captain of the Athenians who followed Menestheus son of Peteos among the picked men of the host when the battle raged at the ships — no homonym in the atlas.

story.text: When the wall was breached, Menestheus led the picked Athenians like a flame of fire, and there followed Pheidas and Stichius and valiant Bias in the press of fighters at the ships of Ajax and Protesilaus.
